// @path: src/app/ops/page.tsx
// @expect: OPS-IMPORT-ALLOWLIST
// The deny-by-default import allowlist used to skip every specifier starting
// with a dot. "@/lib/teacherNav" failed and "../../lib/teacherNav" passed, so
// the allowlist was bypassable by typing a different path separator.
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";
import { teacherNav } from "../../lib/teacherNav";

export default async function OpsHome() {
  await requireOperator();
  return <nav>{teacherNav(0).length}</nav>;
}
